नुत्त(न्न) p. p.
1 Pushed, driven
onward, propelled &c.
--2 Driven
away, dispelled.

नूनं ind.
1 Certainly, assuredly,
surely, verily, indeed; अद्यापि नूनं
हरकोपवह्निस्त्वयि ज्वलत्यौर्व इवांबुराशौ
Ś. 3. 3; Me. 9, 18, 46; Bh. 1. 11;
Ku. 1. 12, 5. 75; R. 1. 29.
--2
Most probably, in all probability.
U. 4. 23.
--3 Ved. Now; just now,
[]
just.
--4 Immediately.
--5 In future.
--6 Now then, therefore.
